answer: Every work slot sits behind a single narrow inlet: to claim one, an identity must burn 50 credits, destroyed forever. A nebula of fresh identities looks impressive, but each clone pays the same 50 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 credits for slots that earn nothing without real work. The old fable that identities are free dies here: an honest agent pays once and keeps earning, while an idle slot forfeits its deposit after three epochs.
